flows.name: Look at and compare the plans
steps: The person reaches the plans section from the entry points the owner chooses (open question on visibility and location).
The four plans appear in order Free, second tier, Designer, Designer Max, each with name, monthly price, included tools and limits.
On a phone the person moves between plans without losing which tools each one adds over the previous one.

screens_states: Plans section as the chosen audience sees it (signed out only if the owner makes it public).
A plan whose tool is not available yet, only if the owner keeps such tools in the catalogue (open question 5).
Phone, tablet and desktop widths; light and dark theme; keyboard and screen-reader order matching the visual plan order.

routes: New section; its route and navigation entry depend on the owner's answer on visibility and location.
components: REQ-021 SP-2 account menu MenuCuenta (planned, not on origin/main yet)
existing_surface.notes: New section, not a change to the REQ-021 SP-2 administration screens: the owner removed the plan side panel «Cada persona. Sus herramientas.» from that design and asked for this section instead. Candidate entry points: the sign-in page, the header menu and the REQ-021 account menu; the owner picks.

must_not_change: REQ-021 SP-2 screens (accounts, roles, sign-in, Mi cuenta) beyond adding a link to this section where the owner places it.
Prices as given by the owner: second tier COP 20,000 / USD 7 per month, Designer COP 45,000 / USD 14 per month.
The Pictures design tokens and type in src/app/globals.css; the visual direction follows the existing app and the REQ-021 «Parte de acceso» rounded surfaces.
Server-side permission checks: the section shows plans, it never grants access by itself.
No purchase, subscription, request or contact action in this subplan: the section is informative first; any plan action is a later subplan decided by open question 2.
copy_rules: Plan names, prices, tools and limits are rendered from the SP-1 catalogue; the screen never retypes them.

Tool names use the labels already used in the app and in REQ-021 (Chat asistido, Contador de globos, Calculadora de costos, Taller 3D) plus the owner's words for the new tools («chat extendido», «detección de estructuras», «detección de globos avanzado»).
No invented marketing copy, taglines, testimonials, discounts, trial or savings claims; any headline or description beyond names, prices, tools and limits needs the owner's words.
Spanish by default, English through the REQ-021 language switch; how COP and USD are shown is the owner's decision.

subplans.title: Access by plan: each account reaches exactly its plan's tools
subplans.outcome: An account assigned to a plan opens and calls exactly the tools that plan includes (basic chat and balloon counter for Free; extended chat, cost calculator, structure detection and advanced balloon detection for Designer; plus the Taller 3D for Designer Max) and is refused every other tool on the server, building on the REQ-021 accounts, roles and permission guard.

subplans.title: Free plan limits
subplans.outcome: A Free account that reaches one of its limits is refused further use of that tool with a message that names the limit, when it resets and where to see the plans; its count restarts at the start of the next period, and an account on a plan without that limit is never refused for usage.

flows.name: Free account reaches a limit
steps: A signed-in Free account uses the basic chat or the balloon counter normally.
The tool shows how much of the current limit is used, in the units the owner defines for the Free plan.
When the limit is reached, the next attempt is refused and the tool shows the limit message instead of a result.
The message names the limit, says when the count resets and links to the plans section.
After the reset moment the tool works again without any action from the person.

screens_states: Basic chat: normal, near the limit, limit reached (input disabled with the limit message).
Balloon counter: normal, near the limit, limit reached.
Limit reached while a request is in flight: the request that crossed the limit gets the refusal, never a partial result.
Phone and desktop widths, light and dark theme.

routes: /asistente (assisted chat on origin/main; REQ-021 SP-7 splits it into the normal chat, balloon counter and cost calculator)
existing_surface.notes: Modifies the tool screens REQ-021 SP-7 creates (chat, balloon counter); they are not on origin/main yet, so the exact surface is pinned when SP-3 is in focus. Limit units, values and period come from the owner (open question), never from the design.

must_not_change: What the chat and the balloon counter answer and how they compute counts (REQ-021 SP-7 behavior).
REQ-021 sign-in, account menu and no-access behavior for tools outside the plan (that is SP-5).
The Pictures design tokens in src/app/globals.css: no new palette, fonts or theme.
copy_rules: Spanish by default, English through the REQ-021 language switch; every string lives in the tool's text module, never inline.
State the limit, the usage and the reset moment with the owner's numbers and units only; no invented marketing copy, discounts or urgency wording.
Plan names and prices come from the SP-1 catalogue, never retyped in the screen.

subplans.title: Plan awareness: current plan marked and locked tools name their plan
subplans.outcome: A signed-in person sees their current plan marked in the plans section, and when they open or are refused a tool their plan does not include, the screen names the lowest plan that includes it and links to the plans section instead of the generic no-access page; the refusal itself stays server-side.

flows.name: See my current plan
steps: A signed-in person opens the plans section.
Their current plan is marked as current; the other plans keep the SP-1 informative layout.

flows.name: Open a tool outside the plan
steps: A signed-in person opens a tool route or follows a link to a tool their plan does not include.
The server refuses it as REQ-021 already does.
The person sees the tool's name, the lowest plan that includes it and a link to the plans section.
Following the link opens the plans section with that plan in view.

screens_states: Plans section signed in with the current plan marked, one variant per plan.
Tool locked, page entry (replaces the generic no-access content for tools that belong to a plan).
Tool locked inside navigation or a menu entry, if the owner wants locked tools listed rather than hidden (decided with SP-5 in focus).
Staff-only areas (spend, administration) keep the generic no-access content: they are not plan tools.
Phone and desktop widths, light and dark theme.

routes: The SP-1 plans section (new in this requirement)
/sin-acceso (planned by REQ-021 T1.4, not on origin/main yet)
existing_surface.notes: Extends the REQ-021 no-access page only for plan tools; exact surface pinned once REQ-021 SP-1 and SP-7 are on main.

must_not_change: Server-side enforcement and the REQ-021 permission keys' meaning.
Generic no-access behavior for staff-only areas.
The Pictures design tokens in src/app/globals.css.
copy_rules: Name the tool and the plan from the SP-1 catalogue; no invented persuasion copy.
Spanish by default, English through the REQ-021 language switch.
